(b) There is NO Complex.abs_reIm, NO norm_sq, NO Complex.normSq_re_im, NO abs_pow_two, NO lt_sqrt in this build - the working replacements: Complex.norm_def (‖z‖ = √(normSq z)) + Complex.normSq_apply (normSq z = z.re·z.re + z.im·z.im); Complex.sq_norm (‖z‖² = normSq z); sq_lt_sq (a² < b² ↔ |a| < |b|) + abs_mul_abs_self; Real.sqrt_lt' (hy : 0 < y) : √x < y ↔ x < y²; Real.sqrt_sq (h : 0 ≤ x) : √(x²) = x (reverse via .symm for the explicit-LHS form); Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt (hx : 0 ≤ x) (h : x < y) : √x < √y. (c) rw [← Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)] with an UNBOUND x-meta fails with 'Invalid rewrite argument: pattern is a metavariable' - provide the side as an explicit have: `have h1 : ‖s - C‖ = Real.sqrt (‖s - C‖ ^ 2) := (Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)).symm` (the .symm form fixes x := ‖s-C‖ and avoids ambiguous subterm matching). (d) Mixed ℝ→ℂ coercion literals do NOT unify definitionally: (1/2 : ℝ) coerced into ℂ is not defeq to the ℂ-literal (1/2 : ℂ) (coercion vs field literal), so `have hC : C = (1/2 : ℂ) + T02·I := rfl` FAILS when the def C was written with an ℝ-literal - write the def with ℂ-literals from the start (def C : ℂ := (1/2 : ℂ) + (T02 : ℂ) * Complex.I) or avoid the literal matching entirely (compute z.re/z.im with simp [sub_re] instead). (e) linarith/assumption do NOT see through noncomputable top-level defs: `linarith` on the goal 0 < R fails while R := √(...) + Δ is still folded - dsimp [R, Δ] first (both R and the slack Δ need unfolding for the rational arithmetic). (f) dist x y is NOT definitionally ‖x - y‖: `rwa [Metric.mem_ball] at hs` gives dist s C < R, which then fails `assumption` against ‖s-C‖ < R - bridge with Complex.dist_eq (dist z w = ‖z - w‖, Norm.lean:232) or keep the whole chain in dist. (g) Complex.abs_re_le_norm/abs_im_le_norm (Analysis/Complex/Norm.lean:38/185) : |z.re| ≤ ‖z‖, |z.im| ≤ ‖z‖ - combined with rw [← sub_re (z := s) (w := C)] gives |s.re - C.re| ≤ ‖s - C‖ directly (there is no Complex.abs_re_sub). (h) A bare `simp` (default set) closes re/im computations like (1 - (1/2 + T02·I)).re = 2⁻¹ EXCEPT the final 1 - 2⁻¹ = 2⁻¹ step which needs norm_num; `simp only` with an explicit re/im lemma list is brittle (misses the literal arithmetic) - prefer `simp` + `norm_num`. (i) `constructor` fails on |x| < a goals (not an And) - use abs_lt.mpr ⟨...⟩. (j) new linters active in this build: linter.flexible (no rigid tactic after non-only simp - e.g. `simp` then `norm_num` is OK since norm_num is a stopper) and linter.unusedVariables (unused theorem parameters need a _ prefix: the band-height hypothesis of disk_bandWidth is _him).
